reason: I have an iPhone, so right now it's a website I'd have to remember to open, and remembering stuff is exactly what I'm bad at. My late fees came from renewals I forgot about, and this only knows what I snap a photo of. It won't see a charge coming.
objection: With no bank login it can't catch the renewal I forgot. I'd have to type in every subscription myself, and if I were that organized I wouldn't be getting late fees.
would_change_my_mind: An iPhone app that pings me a few days before a renewal or bill is due, even if I had to add the subscriptions myself once.
